operators.name: unfold_forward

returns.shape: [N, C * kernel_h * kernel_w, L] where L = ((H + 2*padding_h - dilation_h*(kernel_h-1) - 1) / stride_h + 1) * ((W + 2*padding_w - dilation_w*(kernel_w-1) - 1) / stride_w + 1)

semantics: Corresponds to F.unfold(input, kernel_size=(kernel_h, kernel_w), dilation=(dilation_h, dilation_w), padding=(padding_h, padding_w), stride=(stride_h, stride_w)).
Input is 4D tensor of shape [N, C, H, W] on CUDA.
Output is 3D tensor of shape [N, C*K_h*K_w, L], where L = out_h * out_w, out_h = floor((H + 2*p_h - d_h*(k_h-1) - 1)/s_h + 1), out_w similarly.

For each batch n, output channel index ck = c * K_h * K_w + k, spatial index l corresponds to (out_row, out_col) row-major over output spatial grid. The value is input[n, c, out_row*s_h + k_h*d_h, out_col*s_w + k_w*d_w], where k = k_h * K_w + k_w.
All parameters are integers; kernel, dilation, padding, stride positive (padding>=0).
Output dtype float32, device cuda, contiguous.

operators.name: batch_norm1d_inference_forward
semantics: Applies BatchNorm1d in inference mode: output[n,c,l] = (input[n,c,l] - running_mean[c]) / sqrt(running_var[c] + eps) * weight[c] + bias[c].
If weight is None, treat as ones; if bias is None, treat as zeros.
Input is 3D tensor of shape [N, C, L]; normalization is over channel dimension C independently per batch and spatial position.
All tensors on CUDA, float32; output same shape.
Calls unfold_forward with kernel_h=3, kernel_w=3, dilation_h=2, dilation_w=2, padding_h=0, padding_w=0, stride_h=1, stride_w=1.
Output values extracted from input according to im2col with dilation 2 and stride 1.
Calls batch_norm1d_inference_forward with weight=self.bn.weight, bias=self.bn.bias, running_mean=self.bn.running_mean, running_var=self.bn.running_var, eps=self.bn.eps (default 1e-5).
Uses running statistics (eval mode), no batch statistics.
Returns the tensor produced by batch_norm1d_inference_forward.
